grants.name: Small Business Revitalization (SBR) Grant Program
grants.organization: Georgia Coalition of Black Chambers (GCBC) & Advancing Black Businesses Foundation (ABBF)
grants.eligibility: Georgia-based Black-owned and historically under-resourced small businesses seeking capital support, technical assistance, and business expansion.
grants.description: State-supported grant providing direct capital grants up to $15,000 and technical assistance to small businesses in Georgia to drive operational expansion and economic growth.

grants.name: Galaxy Grant
grants.eligibility: U.S.-based minority-owned or women-owned small businesses and startups. Free entry, instant registration.
grants.description: Fast-entry cash grant designed to support women and minority entrepreneurs with non-dilutive capital for inventory, marketing, and working capital.

grants.name: Invest Atlanta Small Business Improvement Grant (SBIG)
grants.eligibility: Metro Atlanta small businesses and commercial properties located within eligible Tax Allocation Districts (TADs) under 15,000 sq ft.
grants.description: Substantial capital grant up to $50,000 to assist small businesses with commercial facility buildout, equipment upgrades, and production expansion.

grants.name: Tory Burch Foundation Fellows Program & Grant
grants.amount: $5,000 Cash Grant + Fellowship & Access to 0% Interest Loans
grants.eligibility: For-profit U.S. small businesses that are majority woman/diverse-owned (operating at least 1-2 years) with scalable business models.
grants.description: Premier fellowship offering $5,000 in non-dilutive capital, 50+ hours of executive education, national peer network, and direct access to zero-interest loan capital.

grants.name: NASE Growth Grants
grants.deadline: Quarterly (Q3 Closes September 30, 2026 / Q4 Closes December 31, 2026)
grants.eligibility: U.S. micro-businesses, print shops, and independent small business owners for specific growth projects (equipment purchases, marketing, technology).
grants.description: Year-round small business grant offering $4,000 quarterly awards for targeted investments in manufacturing equipment, software, and marketing.
